references.text: The priest takes a handful of the flour and oil together with all the incense as a memorial portion (azkara) and burns it on the altar, just as in the jealousy offering.
Describes how the priest is to take the memorial portion from the grain offering and burn it on the altar as a food offering to the Lord.
The priest burns the memorial portion on the altar as a food offering to the Lord, following the same ritual as in the jealousy offering.
Instructions about the grain offering and how the priest is to take a handful and burn the memorial portion on the altar.
Introduces the grain offering (mincha) used in the jealousy ritual, which is later burned on the altar.
Earlier verses in the same ritual describing that the priest is to give the woman the bitter water to drink and wave the grain offering.
